Saturnalia Honey Cakes

Served at: Saturnalia

Makes about 12-15 small cakes (Serves 6-8)Prep 20 minCook 25-30 min

During Saturnalia, the ancient Roman festival of feasting and revelry, simple yet delicious treats were enjoyed by all. These Honey Cakes, reminiscent of ancient Roman confections, offer a taste of that festive spirit, symbolizing abundance and sweetness during the darkest days of winter. They are a perfect, easy-to-make addition to any Saturnalia celebration.

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 cups (180 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup (120 ml) olive oil
  • 1/2 cup (120 ml) honey, plus extra for drizzling
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1/4 cup (60 ml) milk or water
  • 1 tablespoon poppy seeds or sesame seeds (optional, for garnish)

Method

  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour and salt.
  3. In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the olive oil, honey, eggs, and milk (or water) until well combined.
  4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix with a spoon or spatula until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; the dough will be thick.
  5. Drop spoonfuls (about 1 1/2 tablespoons each) of the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving approximately 2 inches (5 cm) between them as they will not spread significantly.
  6. If desired, sprinkle the tops of the cakes with poppy seeds or sesame seeds.
  7. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cakes are golden brown and feel firm to the touch.
  8. Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let the cakes cool on the sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
  9. Serve warm or at room temperature, optionally drizzled with additional honey for extra sweetness.

Tips

  • For a more authentic ancient Roman flavor, use a robust extra virgin olive oil.
  • These cakes are dense and moist, similar in texture to a scone or a thick cookie, rather than a light, fluffy cake.
  • Store any leftover honey cakes in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days to maintain their freshness.
